summary: The notebook currently holds two notes: a foundations course note on gradient descent and a reading note on the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: Covers gradient descent basics: the update rule, gradient direction, learning-rate trade-offs, and a one-step quadratic example.
areas.gap: No notes yet on advanced optimizers, convexity, or generalization theory despite the gradient-descent note gesturing toward them.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: Covers the Transformer architecture: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional encodings, and reported WMT 2014 BLEU scores.
areas.gap: No notes on sub-quadratic attention variants, rotary or relative positional encodings, or training-stability recipes that the critique identifies as follow-ups.
